description: Forge app for Bitbucket: scores a pull request's risk and shows the top reasons in plain language.
name: pr-risk-scorer

scripts.demo: tsc src/scoring.ts --ignoreConfig --outDir build-test --module commonjs --target es2022 --esModuleInterop && node demo/run-demo.mjs
scripts.test: tsc src/scoring.ts --ignoreConfig --outDir build-test --module commonjs --target es2022 --esModuleInterop && node --test tests/scoring.test.mjs
